
{{alias}}( ndims )
    Returns a kernel for applying a one-dimensional strided array function to
    an input ndarray according to a callback function.

    The returned function has the following parameters:

    - fcn: function which will be applied to a one-dimensional input subarray
    according to a callback function.
    - arrays: array containing an input ndarray descriptor, followed by any
    additional ndarray arguments.
    - ref: original input ndarray provided to a callback function.
    - views: initialized ndarray descriptors representing subarray views.
    - shape: loop dimensions.
    - stridesX: loop dimension strides for the input ndarray.
    - strategyX: strategy for marshaling data to and from an input ndarray
    view.
    - ibuf: workspace for storing iteration indices.
    - ldims: list of loop dimensions.
    - cdims: list of "core" dimensions.
    - options: function options which are passed through to `fcn`.
    - hasOpts: boolean indicating whether to pass an options argument to a
    strided array function.
    - clbk: callback function.
    - thisArg: callback execution context.

    If `ndims` is greater than the maximum supported number of loop dimensions,
    the function returns `null`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    ndims: integer
        Number of loop dimensions.

    Returns
    -------
    fcn: Function|null
        Kernel function.

    Examples
    --------
    > var f = {{alias}}( 2 )
    <Function>


{{alias}}.kernel0d( fcn, arr, ref, v, sh, sx, st, ib, ld, cd, o, po, cb, ctx )
    Applies a one-dimensional strided array function to an input ndarray
    according to a callback function.

    The `v`, `sh`, and `sx` parameters are unused. Providing empty arrays for
    these parameters is recommended in order to ensure a monomorphic API.

    Parameters
    ----------
    fcn: Function
        Wrapper for a one-dimensional strided array function.

    arr: Array<Object>
        Array containing an input ndarray descriptor, followed by any
        additional ndarray arguments.

    ref: ndarray
        Original input ndarray provided to a callback function.

    v: Array<Object>
        Initialized ndarray descriptors representing subarray views.

    sh: Array<integer>
        Loop dimensions. Should have zero elements.

    sx: Array<integer>
        Loop dimension strides for the input ndarray.

    st: Object
        Strategy for marshaling data to and from an input ndarray view.

    ib: Array<integer>
        Workspace for storing iteration indices.

    ld: Array<integer>
        List of loop dimensions.

    cd: Array<integer>
        List of "core" dimensions.

    o: Object
        Function options which are passed through to `fcn`.

    po: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether to pass an options argument to a strided
        array function.

    cb: Function
        Callback function.

    ctx: any
        Callback execution context.


{{alias}}.kernel1d( fcn, arr, ref, v, sh, sx, st, ib, ld, cd, o, po, cb, ctx )
    Applies a one-dimensional strided array function to an input ndarray
    according to a callback function.

    Parameters
    ----------
    fcn: Function
        Wrapper for a one-dimensional strided array function.

    arr: Array<Object>
        Array containing an input ndarray descriptor, followed by any
        additional ndarray arguments.

    ref: ndarray
        Original input ndarray provided to a callback function.

    v: Array<Object>
        Initialized ndarray descriptors representing subarray views.

    sh: Array<integer>
        Loop dimensions. Should have one element.

    sx: Array<integer>
        Loop dimension strides for the input ndarray.

    st: Object
        Strategy for marshaling data to and from an input ndarray view.

    ib: Array<integer>
        Workspace for storing iteration indices.

    ld: Array<integer>
        List of loop dimensions.

    cd: Array<integer>
        List of "core" dimensions.

    o: Object
        Function options which are passed through to `fcn`.

    po: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether to pass an options argument to a strided
        array function.

    cb: Function
        Callback function.

    ctx: any
        Callback execution context.


{{alias}}.kernel2d( fcn, arr, ref, v, sh, sx, st, ib, ld, cd, o, po, cb, ctx )
    Applies a one-dimensional strided array function to an input ndarray
    according to a callback function.

        Wrapper for a one-dimensional strided array function.

    arr: Array<Object>

    ref: ndarray
        Original input ndarray provided to a callback function.

    v: Array<Object>
        Initialized ndarray descriptors representing subarray views.

    sh: Array<integer>

    sx: Array<integer>
        Loop dimension strides for the input ndarray.

    st: Object
        Strategy for marshaling data to and from an input ndarray view.

    ib: Array<integer>
        Workspace for storing iteration indices.

{{alias}}.kernel3d( fcn, arr, ref, v, sh, sx, st, ib, ld, cd, o, po, cb, ctx )
    Applies a one-dimensional strided array function to an input ndarray
    according to a callback function.

    Parameters
    ----------
    fcn: Function
        Wrapper for a one-dimensional strided array function.

    arr: Array<Object>
        Array containing an input ndarray descriptor, followed by any
        additional ndarray arguments.

    ref: ndarray
        Original input ndarray provided to a callback function.

    v: Array<Object>
        Initialized ndarray descriptors representing subarray views.

    sh: Array<integer>
        Loop dimensions. Should have three elements.

    sx: Array<integer>
        Loop dimension strides for the input ndarray.

    st: Object
        Strategy for marshaling data to and from an input ndarray view.

    ib: Array<integer>
        Workspace for storing iteration indices.

    ld: Array<integer>
        List of loop dimensions.

    cd: Array<integer>
        List of "core" dimensions.

    o: Object
        Function options which are passed through to `fcn`.

    po: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether to pass an options argument to a strided
        array function.

    cb: Function
        Callback function.

    ctx: any
        Callback execution context.
